metadata.title: University of Ghana, Legon: master geography

gameFrame.axes: x = metres east of the datum, z = metres south of the datum

metadata.extent: the legacy OSM extract (5.633-5.668 N, 0.199-0.175 W) plus everything within 150 m of the OSM campus boundary

confidence.high: two or more independent sources agree (or OSM geometry confirmed by satellite footprints / written claims)
confidence.medium: one reliable source, or interpretive (zones, derived shapes)
confidence.low: sources conflict or a written claim fails

metadata.license: Contains OpenStreetMap data (ODbL), Google Open Buildings (CC-BY-4.0), Microsoft ML Buildings (ODbL), Overture Maps places (CDLA-Permissive-2.0), ESA WorldCover 2021 (CC-BY-4.0), Copernicus DEM and modified Copernicus Sentinel data.

properties.name: Central academic core
properties.rationale: Departments, faculties and the library on the north side of the avenue around University Square.

properties.name: Botanical Gardens and northern woodland
properties.rationale: The 92 ha Botanical Gardens (with the Vaughan Dam) and the wooded land between them and the academic core.

properties.name: East of the N4
properties.rationale: University land east of J.J. Rawlings Avenue (N4): the UGBS Graduate Campus, the University Hospital and Legon police station.

properties.name: Main Gate and eastern academic strip
properties.rationale: Between the academic core and the N4: JQB, Institute of African Studies, Law, KAB, Engineering, Performing Arts and Agriculture, entered through the Main Gate.

properties.name: Legon Hill and the Convocation Group
properties.rationale: The summit (DEM high point ~150 m) carrying the Great Hall, Registry/central administration and Vice-Chancellor's residence, and Commonwealth Hall on its eastern slope at the head of the avenue.

properties.name: Night Market, Banking Square and the international hostels
properties.rationale: The commercial and social hub south of the traditional halls.

properties.name: Northern hostels
properties.rationale: Pentagon, Bani, Evandy and TF/James Topp Nelson Yankah hostels along the west side of the N4, north of the academic core.

properties.name: UG Medical Centre and the southern edge
anchors: University of Ghana Medical Center Limited
properties.rationale: The UG Medical Centre and the southern tip of the campus, outside the legacy map's extract.

properties.name: Southern halls and health sciences
anchors: Noguchi Memorial Institute for Medical Research
properties.rationale: The newer halls (Limann, Kwapong, Sey, JNA), the School of Public Health, College of Health Sciences and Noguchi.

properties.name: Sports precinct
properties.rationale: The stadium, practice pitches, gymnasium, pool and sports directorate by the Okponglo end of the N4.

properties.name: Staff residential (Legon Hill slopes)
properties.rationale: Detached staff houses on curving crescents west and south-west of the halls (Lower Hill Drive, F.K. Apaloo Crescent, Ayido Crescent and others).

properties.name: Traditional halls and the Athletic Oval
properties.rationale: South of the avenue across from University Square: Legon, Akuafo and Mensah Sarbah halls with their annexes, Valco, the CC, the SRC building and the sports fields between them.

properties.name: Western woodland, farms and research plots
properties.rationale: Largely undeveloped wooded and scrub land west of Legon Hill, with the aquaculture ponds and agricultural plots in the north-west.
